articles.title: Over 1,000 People Killed in Massive China-Nepal Border Mudslide
articles.summary: A catastrophic mudslide struck the border region between China and Nepal on 26 August, and rescue teams are still searching for survivors. The death toll has now passed 1,000, making it one of the deadliest natural disasters in the region in recent years. The disaster was triggered by heavy monsoon rains, which caused huge amounts of rock, mud, and water to rush down mountain slopes at tremendous speed. Several hydroelectric power tunnels in Nepal were badly damaged. Families of victims gathered near the disaster zone, desperately hoping for news of their loved ones. Aid workers and soldiers from both countries have been working around the clock to find survivors and clear the debris.

lv1: Where did the mudslide happen? (泥石流發生在哪裏？)
What caused the mudslide to occur? (是什麼原因導致泥石流發生？)
lv2: Why do mudslides happen more often during the monsoon season, and what does this tell us about the relationship between weather and natural disasters? (為什麼泥石流在季候風季節更常發生？這告訴我們天氣與自然災害有什麼關係？)
How might the damage to hydroelectric tunnels affect the people living in Nepal, and why is electricity so important? (水力發電隧道受損會怎樣影響尼泊爾居民？為什麼電力如此重要？)
lv3: Some scientists say that climate change is making monsoon rains heavier and more dangerous. Do you think governments in Asia should spend more money on disaster prevention or on disaster relief after it happens? Explain your view with reasons. (部分科學家認為氣候變化令季候風雨量更大、更危險。你認為亞洲各國政府應花更多資源在災難預防上，還是災後救援？請說明你的理由。)

When a disaster crosses two countries' borders, like this one affecting both China and Nepal, who should be responsible for leading the rescue and the recovery effort? Should there be international rules about this? (當災難橫跨兩個國家邊界，例如同時影響中國和尼泊爾，誰應該負責主導救援和重建工作？是否應該有國際規則來處理這類情況？)

articles.title: Tropical Cyclone Sadhel Nears Hong Kong, Signal No. 1 Raised
articles.summary: Hong Kong's Observatory has issued Standby Signal No. 1 as Tropical Cyclone Sadhel moves closer to the region. The storm passed roughly 200 kilometres southeast of Hong Kong on the afternoon of 1 September and is expected to strengthen and draw nearer to the Guangdong coast overnight and into 2 September. Winds are gradually increasing across the city. The Observatory explained that the storm's interaction with a northeast monsoon is causing mostly northerly winds in Hong Kong. Officials are monitoring Sadhel's intensity closely and will consider raising the warning signal if local wind conditions worsen. Residents are advised to stay informed and take precautions.

lv1: What signal did Hong Kong's Observatory issue because of Typhoon Sadhel? (香港天文台因沙德爾而發出了什麼號數信號？)
In which direction was the storm located relative to Hong Kong? (相對於香港，風暴位於哪個方向？)
lv2: Why does the Hong Kong Observatory watch both the storm's strength and its distance from the city before changing the warning signal? (為什麼香港天文台在更改警告信號之前，要同時留意風暴的強度和距離？)
How does a northeast monsoon interacting with a typhoon affect the wind and weather conditions in Hong Kong? (東北季候風與颱風相互影響，會怎樣改變香港的風力和天氣狀況？)
lv3: Hong Kong's typhoon warning system has remained largely unchanged for decades. With advances in technology and weather forecasting, should the city redesign how it communicates typhoon risks to the public? What improvements would you suggest? (香港的颱風警告系統數十年來基本上維持不變。隨著科技和天氣預報進步，香港是否應該重新設計向市民傳達颱風風險的方式？你會建議哪些改善方法？)

Climate scientists predict that typhoons in the western Pacific may become stronger but less frequent due to climate change. If this happens, how should governments and schools prepare differently compared to today? (氣候科學家預測，由於氣候變化，西太平洋颱風可能變得更強但頻率降低。如果這成真，政府和學校應如何與現在不同地作出準備？)

articles.title: 《小學概覽2026》出爐　全港小一班數繼續下跌
articles.summary: 《小學概覽2026》於9月1日公布，明報統計全港446間官立及資助小學的最新數據，發現本學年小一班數較上學年再度減少。這反映本港學齡兒童人口持續下降的趨勢。有學校為吸引更多學生報讀，積極拓展特色課程及跨境招生。教育界人士指出，部分學校面臨收生不足壓力，長遠可能影響辦學可持續性。當局表示會繼續密切監察各區學校的收生情況，並按需要調整資源分配，以確保教育質素不受影響。

lv1: 《小學概覽2026》發現全港小一班數有什麼變化？
香港現時有多少間官立及資助小學？
lv2: 為什麼香港的學齡兒童人數會持續減少？這對學校有什麼影響？
學校為了吸引更多學生，可以採取哪些方法？你認為哪種方法最有效？
lv3: 有人認為收生不足的學校應該合併或關閉，以節省教育資源；但也有人認為保留小型學校能提供更個人化的教育。你認同哪個觀點？為什麼？
人口下降是否意味着政府應該減少教育開支？還是反而應該投放更多資源提升教育質素？請從不同角度分析。

articles.title: 熱帶氣旋沙德爾逼近　天文台料本港風力今晚逐步上升
articles.summary: 天文台於9月1日下午發表預測，指熱帶氣旋沙德爾當時在本港東南約200公里外掠過，預料今晚（9月2日）起逐漸增強，並靠近廣東東部沿岸，本港風力將會逐步上升。受沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響，本港現時普遍吹偏北風。天文台指出，會密切監察沙德爾的強度、強風範圍與珠江口的距離，以及本地實際風力變化，再決定是否需要發出更高號數的熱帶氣旋警告信號，提醒市民留意最新消息。

lv1: 天文台預料沙德爾會在何時令香港風力上升？
沙德爾與什麼天氣系統共同影響香港？
lv2: 天文台在考慮是否提升颱風信號時，需要參考哪些因素？為什麼這些因素都很重要？
颱風靠近時，市民和學校應該如何做好準備？
lv3: 有意見認為香港的颱風停課機制已經過時，應以科學數據取代固定信號作為停課標準。你是否同意？這樣做有什麼好處和壞處？
隨著氣候變化，颱風變得更加難以預測。政府、學校和個人各自應承擔怎樣的責任，以減低颱風帶來的傷害？
